name: Glimo status
summary: Teaches any agent to show its real status on your vitrina and to wait for your decision before anything sensitive.
summaryEs: Enseña a cualquier agente a mostrar su estado real en tu vitrina y a esperar tu decisión antes de algo sensible.

name: Inbox digest
summary: Reads your inbox every morning and leaves you three lines for each thread that matters.
summaryEs: Lee tu bandeja cada mañana y te deja tres líneas por cada hilo importante.

name: Sales follow-up
summary: Finds customers who never answered and drafts the follow-up email for you to approve.
summaryEs: Detecta clientes sin respuesta y prepara el correo de seguimiento para que lo apruebes.

name: Invoice matching
summary: Matches invoices against your bank movements and tells you what does not add up.
summaryEs: Cruza facturas con los movimientos del banco y te avisa de lo que no cuadra.

name: Tender radar
summary: Checks public procurement portals and brings back only the tenders that fit your company.
summaryEs: Revisa portales públicos y te trae solo las licitaciones que encajan con tu empresa.

name: Clash-free calendar
summary: Reorders meetings around your priorities and protects your focus hours.
summaryEs: Reordena reuniones según tus prioridades y protege tus horas de foco.

name: Social calendar
summary: Schedules your posts and shows you which ones need your OK before they go out.
summaryEs: Programa publicaciones y te muestra cuáles necesitan tu visto bueno antes de salir.
